name: Six Senses Crans-Montana
positioning: Ski-in, ski-out Alpine hotel in Crans-Montana with a contemporary take on the Swiss chalet
best_for: Skiers who want direct slope access in winter
Summer golfers and wellness travelers in the Swiss Alps

facts.text: The hotel has direct ski-in and ski-out access on the Chetzeron red slope.
The hotel is just above the main gondola in Crans.
The hotel is close to the center of Crans-Montana, with views toward the Matterhorn and Mont Blanc.
An authentic Swiss chalet feel was remodeled into a contemporary, airy style.
Terrace Rooms and Suites are slope-side with balconies facing the final turn of the Chetzeron piste.
Six Senses Spa blends high-tech biohacking with high-touch therapies.
Wellness includes a post-ski Stretch Pod, thermal journeys and therapies with an Alpine twist.
The hotel has a rooftop swimming pool.
The hotel has an open-air cinema.
There are two restaurants and a lounge, plus in-room dining and chef on call.
Crans-Montana offers winter snow sports and summer golf and equestrian pursuits.
